name: How long after a car accident can I file a personal injury claim in San Diego?

mainEntity.name: How long after a car accident can I file a personal injury claim in San Diego?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most claims must be filed within two years of the accident date; shorter deadlines apply if a government vehicle is involved.selfhelp.courts.ca​
